title: ProjectFile
description: The canonical project master file schema. This is what is saved to HDF5 and round-tripped without data loss. The source of truth is always the project file, not any STEP export.

schemaVersion.description: Semver string for this schema. Bump when adding required fields or removing fields.

appVersion.description: Version of the application that wrote this file.

exportTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this file was last saved.

creatorMetadata.description: Optional arbitrary creator metadata (author, institution, etc.).

displayUnits.description: The unit system shown in the UI. Physics is always SI internally; this is a display preference only.

groups.description: All groups. Each coilId in a group must reference an existing coil.
